display.purpose: Homepage hero headlines and brand statements only. Maximum 4-6 words per line. Never in the product catalog.

headline.purpose: Section titles on the homepage, product name at top of PDP.

title.purpose: Navigation links, card product names, modal titles, form section headers.

body.purpose: Product descriptions, cart line items, checkout form labels. Max line length 65ch.

label.purpose: Price badges, filter chips, category tags, button text. All-caps only at this scale.

motion.name: ease-product
motion.purpose: Standard ease-out for product card image scale, button background transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color/opacity transitions (nav link hover, button hover color).

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Transform transitions (product card image scale, page fade-in).

narrative.overview:
This system is built on deliberate restraint. Every screen gives the product image room to speak before any interface element reaches for attention. The brand accent — a warm terracotta — appears selectively, never as decoration, always as direction. Whitespace is the primary design element on brand surfaces; density only appears where the user is transacting.

The catalog surfaces step back entirely. Navigation disappears into the edges. Product photography fills the frame. Typography is light-weight at display scale, medium-weight at functional scale — the contrast signals where to read versus where to act.

This system explicitly rejects: chaotic grids packed with promotion badges, neon sale callouts, discount banners above the fold, stock-photo hero sections, generic SaaS-cream color fields, and the fast-fashion visual language of Shein.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, no shadows — depth from scale contrast and spacing rhythm
Warm terracotta accent on ≤10% of any surface
Inter at 300 weight for display — lightness reads as confidence
Brand-tinted neutrals throughout — no pure #000 or #fff

rules.name: The One Warmth Rule
rules.body: Every neutral must carry a terracotta tint. Chroma 0.005–0.015 is enough. Pure black and pure white are prohibited.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is what makes it feel intentional.

rules.name: The Weight-Two Rule
rules.body: The system uses exactly two functional weights: 300 (editorial) and 500 (functional). Weight 400 for body copy only. No 600, 700, or 800.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If you reach for box-shadow, stop. Use a background-tint shift or a 1px border instead.

dos: Do keep Inter at 300 weight for all display and headline text
Do leave generous whitespace between sections — 96px between major blocks on desktop
Do use the terracotta accent on primary CTA hover states, active nav states, and focus rings only
Do tint every neutral toward terracotta (chroma 0.005 minimum)
Do use sharp corners (border-radius: 0) on all interactive controls
Do keep product card hover effects subtle — 103% scale over 300ms
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on all transitions
Do treat the homepage as a brand statement — one hero, one headline, one CTA
donts: Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff) anywhere
Don't show discount banners, sale badges, or promotional callouts above the fold
Don't pack the homepage with a product grid
Don't use rounded corners on buttons or inputs
Don't use side-stripe border accents (border-left > 1px as colored stripe)
Don't repeat the terracotta accent more than 10% of any screen
Don't use uppercase text above label scale
Don't stack multiple promotions or CTAs
